entities.name: Henri Romagnesi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri Charles Louis Romagnesi was a French mycologist who was notable for a thorough review and monograph of the agaric genus Entoloma, as well as extensive work on the large genus Russula, of which he described several new species.
